parts.text: State what is meant by the wavelength of a progressive wave.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A cathode-ray oscilloscope (CRO) is used to analyse a sound wave. The screen of the CRO is shown in Fig. 5.1.

{{figure:figure_5_1.png}}

The time-base setting of the CRO is $2.5\text{ ms cm}^{-1}$.

Determine the frequency of the sound wave.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Explain why an intensity maximum is detected at point C.

parts.text: Determine the difference between the times taken for the sound to travel from the source to point C along the two different paths.
